query: SELECT date_bin('8 hours',ts,TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 04:00:00+00') AS block_start,symbol,(array_agg(open ORDER BY ts))[1] AS first_open,(array_agg(close ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] AS last_close,sum(quote_asset_volume) AS quote_turnover,sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume) AS signed_taker_quote,sum(power(ln(close/open),2)) AS minute_squared_return,count(*) AS source_rows,count(DISTINCT ts) AS distinct_rows,min(ts) AS first_ts,max(ts) AS last_ts,bool_and(open>0 AND high>0 AND low>0 AND close>0 AND high>=greatest(open,close,low) AND low<=least(open,close,high) AND quote_asset_volume>=0 AND taker_buy_quote>=0 AND taker_buy_quote<=quote_asset_volume) AS coherent FROM bars_binance WHERE symbol=ANY(:symbols) AND interval='1m' AND ts>=:start AND ts<:end GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
